The builder applies the following default configuration:

- Port: `5672` (see `EventHubsBuilder.EventHubsPort`)
- Port: `5300` (see `EventHubsBuilder.EventHubsHttpPort`)
- Wait strategy: Waits until a message matching `Emulator Service is Successfully Up!` is logged.
- Wait strategy: Waits until the HTTP request `GET /health` to port `5300` is completed successfully.
